column1: # Kinematic chain configuration for 3-axis mill visualization.
# Units: millimetres and degrees, Z up (same as every chain TSV).
# 22-column format: obj_file plus mesh_off/mesh_rot/mesh_scale. An empty
# obj_file falls back to the name-keyed placeholder primitive; setting it
# routes through the OBJ registry -> importer -> MachineModel::per_axis[].
# The base is the unit demo_box.obj scaled to 1200 mm and sunk so its top
# face sits at Z=0 under the X/Y travel.
